description: Test prompts that verify rdk-peripheral-cookbook triggers and produces correct, board-aware peripheral-driving guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: s100-can-not-socketcan
evals.prompt: 我在 RDK S100 上敲 ip link set can0 type can bitrate 500000 报错没有 can0，CAN 怎么用？
evals.expected_output: Explains S100 CAN is in the MCU domain (no SocketCAN / no can0), routes to CANHAL + /app/Can sample, contrasts with X5.

assertions.text: States that S100 (and S600) CAN is in the MCU domain and there is no can0 SocketCAN device.
Says to use the CANHAL library / IPC and the /app/Can sample (e.g. canhal_send/canhal_get), NOT ip link/cansend/candump.
Notes that ip link + can-utils is the X5-only path (X5 = SocketCAN / TCAN4550).

evals.name: x5-canfd-bringup
evals.prompt: RDK X5 上想跑 CAN FD，仲裁 500K 数据段 2M，命令怎么写？
evals.expected_output: Gives the X5 SocketCAN CAN FD bringup with bitrate/dbitrate/fd on and an FD frame send.

assertions.text: Uses ip link set can0 type can bitrate 500000 dbitrate 2000000 fd on (arbitration + data phase, fd on).
Sends an FD frame with cansend using ## (FD) syntax, and/or mentions candump to receive.

evals.name: multi-servo-pca9685
evals.prompt: 想在 RDK X5 上同时控制 4 个舵机，应该怎么接？
evals.expected_output: Recommends PCA9685 over I2C, with servo power on V+ external supply, never the 40PIN rail; confirm 0x40 via i2cdetect.

assertions.text: Recommends a PCA9685 16-channel PWM expander over I2C (default address 0x40).
Says servo power must come from an external supply (PCA9685 V+ terminal), NOT the 40PIN Pin 2/4 5V rail.
Mentions confirming 0x40 with i2cdetect -y <bus> before driving.

evals.name: ws2812-spi-not-bitbang
evals.prompt: RDK 上接了 WS2812 灯带，用 GPIO 拉高拉低控制不了，怎么搞？
evals.expected_output: Drive WS2812 via SPI MOSI emulation at ~2.4MHz (NeoPixel-SPI); rpi_ws281x not applicable; external power.

assertions.text: Says GPIO bitbang is unreliable and to drive WS2812 via the SPI MOSI pin emulating the 800kHz timing (~2.4MHz, e.g. NeoPixel-SPI).
Notes RPi's rpi_ws281x does not apply on RDK, and/or that the strip needs an external 5V supply (not the 40PIN rail).

evals.name: audio-no-tros-alsa
evals.prompt: 板子上没装 TROS，插了个 USB 麦克风想录音，怎么弄？
evals.expected_output: Use standard ALSA (arecord/aplay), find the card with arecord -l, USB sound card auto-loads snd-usb-audio.

assertions.text: Routes to standard ALSA (no TROS needed): arecord -l to find the card, arecord -D plughw to record, aplay to play back.
Mentions a USB sound card / mic auto-loads snd-usb-audio and appears in aplay -l/arecord -l (universal fallback).

evals.name: gpio-probe-verification
evals.prompt: 想确认板上的 GPIO 行数和 CAN 接口状态，有没有脚本直接查？
evals.expected_output: References the gpio_probe.sh script to read GPIO lines via gpioinfo and CAN interface state in structured JSON.

assertions.text: References or suggests running scripts/gpio_probe.sh (or equivalent gpio_probe.sh) to check GPIO and CAN status.
Mentions the script outputs structured JSON with gpio_lines and/or can_interfaces fields.
Notes the script is read-only and safe (uses gpioinfo not gpioset), or degrades gracefully if libgpiod is not installed.
